protocol: Three fresh loaded-interpreter runs per source and revision at canonical full workloads. Matched randomized sequential rounds, shared timing lock, AC power and Low Power Mode off. Full IO and flush are inside execution time; preparation and whole-process elapsed time retained separately. No source or workload changes.
